first:
It is late! You've put together an incredibly thorough move plan tonight. Here's a quick summary of what you have ready to go:

- Master phased checklist and calendar (.ics and .csv, all 47 events)
- Box inventory sheet with auto-numbering formulas
- Printable labels and color dots
- Mover booking email, SMS, and voicemail for Evergreen (Quote C, $3,600 B-NTE)
- Drive vs Ship budget with totals and payment timeline
- Printable two-page move summary with checklist
- Six-day driving route with winter and dog plans
- Hotel call sheet with script, search queries, and tracking checkboxes

Get some rest. When you're ready to pick this back up, I can help with things like updating the budget after you book hotels, drafting the Portland temporary-housing search, planning Milo's first-week settling routine, or anything else that comes up. Good night, and good luck with the move.

turns.user: I'm good, let's keep going. Next: give me a printable checklist of address-change tasks — grouped by priority (ASAP, 2 weeks before move, day-of/at arrival, after arrival) with one short line per item. Include USPS, DMV, banks/cards, insurers (health/auto/renter), utilities, phone/internet, employer/payroll, tax agencies, voter registration, prescriptions/doctor/vet, pet microchip, subscriptions, online stores, loyalty programs, and anyone else I should think of. For each item, note if they typically require proof of residency (yes/no). Keep lines short so it prints nicely.
turns.text:
```
ADDRESS CHANGE CHECKLIST
Columbus, OH to Portland, OR | Move Day 01/15/2027

ASAP (as soon as you have the new address)
☐ USPS change of address (usps.com, activate on move day)          Proof: No
☐ Employer / payroll (update W-4 and direct deposit address)       Proof: No
☐ Health insurance (update address with plan or marketplace)       Proof: No
☐ Auto insurance (update policy to Oregon address)                 Proof: No
☐ Renter's insurance (start Oregon policy on key date)             Proof: Yes
☐ Banks and checking accounts                                      Proof: No
☐ Credit cards (each one separately)                               Proof: No
☐ Investment and retirement accounts (401k, IRA, brokerage)        Proof: No
☐ Student loan servicer                                            Proof: No
☐ Primary care doctor (request records transfer)                   Proof: No
☐ Dentist (request records transfer)                               Proof: No
☐ Pharmacy / prescriptions (transfer to Oregon pharmacy)           Proof: No
☐ Vet (transfer Milo's records to new Oregon vet)                  Proof: No
☐ Pet microchip registry (update address and phone)                Proof: No

2 WEEKS BEFORE MOVE
☐ Phone carrier (update billing address)                           Proof: No
☐ Internet provider (cancel Ohio, confirm Oregon install)          Proof: No
☐ Electric company (cancel Ohio, start Oregon)                     Proof: Yes (sometimes)
☐ Gas company (cancel Ohio, start Oregon)                          Proof: Yes (sometimes)
☐ Water and sewer (cancel Ohio, start Oregon)                      Proof: Yes (sometimes)
☐ Trash and recycling (cancel Ohio, start Oregon)                  Proof: No
☐ Social Security Administration (ssa.gov or call)                 Proof: No
☐ IRS (file Form 8822 for address change)                         Proof: No
☐ Ohio Dept of Taxation (note part-year resident status)           Proof: No
☐ Oregon Dept of Revenue (register as new resident when filing)    Proof: No
☐ Amazon (update default shipping and billing)                     Proof: No
☐ Other online stores (Target, Walmart, Chewy, etc.)               Proof: No
☐ Subscription boxes (pet supplies, meal kits, etc.)               Proof: No
☐ Streaming services with billing address (Spotify, etc.)          Proof: No
☐ Newspapers and magazines (cancel or update)                      Proof: No
☐ Airline loyalty programs (update mailing address)                Proof: No
☐ Hotel loyalty programs (update mailing address)                  Proof: No
☐ Gym or fitness memberships (cancel Ohio, find Oregon)            Proof: No
☐ Library (return books, cancel Ohio card)                         Proof: No
☐ Religious or community organizations                             Proof: No
☐ Alumni associations                                              Proof: No
☐ Professional licenses or certifications                          Proof: Yes (varies)
☐ Union or trade memberships                                       Proof: No

DAY OF / AT ARRIVAL
☐ Confirm USPS forwarding is active (check informed delivery)     Proof: No
☐ Confirm all Ohio utilities show final billing                    Proof: No
☐ Confirm Oregon utilities are on and working                     Proof: No
☐ Confirm renter's insurance policy is active at new address       Proof: No
☐ Update Google Maps / Apple Maps home address                     Proof: No
☐ Update emergency contacts with new address                       Proof: No
☐ Update ICE contacts in your phone                                Proof: No
☐ Notify close family and friends of new address                   Proof: No

AFTER ARRIVAL (first 2 weeks)
☐ Oregon DMV: driver's license (verify deadline, often ~30 days)   Proof: Yes
☐ Oregon DMV: vehicle registration and title transfer              Proof: Yes
☐ Oregon DEQ emissions test (if Portland metro area)               Proof: No
☐ Cancel Ohio driver's license and plates (after Oregon is done)   Proof: No
☐ Voter registration (sos.oregon.gov, often auto at DMV)           Proof: Yes
☐ Oregon dog license (county or city, check requirements)          Proof: Yes (rabies cert)
☐ Find new Oregon primary care doctor and dentist                  Proof: No
☐ Find new Oregon vet and confirm Milo's records transferred       Proof: No
☐ Update FSA or HSA with new address                               Proof: No
☐ Update life insurance beneficiary address                        Proof: No
☐ Update homeowner's association (if applicable)                   Proof: No
☐ File part-year resident tax returns for OH and OR at tax time    Proof: No

EASY TO FORGET
☐ PayPal, Venmo, Zelle (update address)                            Proof: No
☐ Apple ID and Google account (update billing address)             Proof: No
☐ EZ-Pass or toll accounts (cancel or update)                     Proof: No
☐ Car roadside assistance (AAA, etc.)                              Proof: No
☐ Warranty registrations (appliances, electronics)                 Proof: No
☐ Security system or doorbell camera (cancel Ohio account)         Proof: No
☐ Mail-order prescriptions (update shipping address)               Proof: No
☐ Fantasy sports, gaming accounts                                  Proof: No
☐ Cloud storage or domain registrations                            Proof: No
☐ Any account that mails you a physical card or statement          Proof: No
```
